calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  wo.fulfilment_type,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  SUM(wo.order_total_gross) AS total_value
FROM fact_web_order wo
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON wo.web_order_id = fsl.receipt_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, wo.fulfilment_type
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, wo.fulfilment_type

calls.statement:
WITH web_sales_by_fulfillment AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    wo.fulfilment_type,
    SUM(wo.order_total_gross) AS fulfilment_value
  FROM fact_web_order wo
  INNER JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON wo.web_order_id = fsl.receipt_id
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, wo.fulfilment_type
),
totals_per_period AS (
  SELECT 
    fiscal_year,
    fiscal_period,
    SUM(fulfilment_value) AS total_value
  FROM web_sales_by_fulfillment
  GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  wsf.fiscal_year,
  wsf.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(100.0 * wsf.fulfilment_value / tp.total_value, 2) AS click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM web_sales_by_fulfillment wsf
INNER JOIN totals_per_period tp 
  ON wsf.fiscal_year = tp.fiscal_year 
  AND wsf.fiscal_period = tp.fiscal_period
WHERE wsf.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect'
ORDER BY wsf.fiscal_period
